honest_findings: two-phase design required: censoring the disconfirming channel from t=0 weakens the LOCK as much as the overturn (pre-shift the channel supports the incumbent) and inverts the denial story

the 1/(1-gamma) delay prediction is refuted at mid gamma: delay is flat to gamma=0.9 then explodes -- the incumbent candidate ADAPTS to the anomaly under high attention (Quine-Duhem accommodation), so lock-in is a sharp threshold, not a smooth divergence
mechanism: K=2 candidate paradigms per agent (hub wiring vs no-hub), prequential q(m), damped log-linear hypothesis pooling; crisis = the entropy of q(m); denial = attention cutting the evidence source; social revolution = the vanguard's log-odds propagating to agents who never ran the experiment
